tools.name: niche_signal_scan
tools.description: Scan a niche you describe, right now (Pro). Returns a ranked, sourced slate of the stories people in that field are talking about, with source links, the outlets, and why it matters. For a ready-made briefing use niche_feed_read instead. Assistant access requires Pro. Poll niche_session_state with t

tools.name: niche_intelligence_query
tools.description: Ask an analyst-shaped question over a fresh scan of a niche (Pro): 'the biggest developments this week', 'what is emerging', 'where money is moving'. Returns the sourced slate plus a short synthesis when requested. Returns a session_id; poll niche_session_state until cp1_awaiting_story. For synthesi

tools.name: niche_session_state
tools.description: Read the current state of a scan: status, the ranked stories with their sources and source information, and any angles already proposed. Poll this after niche_signal_scan or niche_intelligence_query until the slate is ready.

tools.name: niche_angle_propose
tools.description: Angles on one story (Pro): up to a few distinct stances a reader could take, each with a hook, the take, and the sources that support it. Pass the session_id from a scan and a story_id from its slate. Nothing is written for you; the angles are starting points.

tools.name: niche_list_sessions
tools.description: List your recent scans: id, the niche you described, status and timestamps. Use it to find a session_id you no longer have.

tools.name: niche_session_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a scan that is still running.

tools.name: niche_whoami
tools.description: Orient in one read-only call: your plan (Free or Pro), the tools this server serves, and the endpoint. Assistant access requires Pro. Call it first if you are unsure what is available.

tools.name: niche_feed_read
tools.description: Read the latest or a dated briefing for a niche: stories, reporting dates, source links, why each story matters, and new or continuing status. Use a slug from https://nicheangle.com/n or a custom niche's URL, such as founders or ai-leaders. Assistant access requires Pro. This reads an existing brief
